svg.title: CDCSynchronizer block diagram
svg.desc: A flop in the source domain, outside the module, drives d. Inside, a chain of stages flops on clk, sync_0 to sync_<stages-1>, each with ASYNC_REG. q is the last stage.
svg.text: CDCSynchronizer: a chain of stages flops
Every stage is clocked by clk, reset by rst_n, and declared with (* ASYNC_REG = "TRUE" *). Thick border: flop.
